\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Basic}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Cube.Reverse.Basic
\section{Overview}
Extended power means retain the geometric-mean value at exponent zero and vanish at nonpositive exponents when the function has a zero. Coordinate identities and positivity properties prepare the reverse hypercontractivity inequalities.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Nonnegative cube functions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsNonnegative}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc}
A real-valued function $f$ on $\{0,1\}^n$ is nonnegative when $f(x)\ge0$ for every cube point $x$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Extended power means]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeLpNorm, BooleanAnalysis.expect}
Let $p\in\bbr$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, define $M_p(f)=0$ when $p\le0$ and $f$ has a zero; otherwise set $M_0(f)=\exp(\E\log|f|)$ and $M_p(f)=(\E|f|^p)^{1/p}$ for $p\ne0$, with uniform expectation.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Positive-exponent formula]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.expect}
\difficulty{1}
For $p>0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the extended power mean agrees with the ordinary formula $M_p(f)=(\E|f|^p)^{1/p}$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Nonnegative positive-exponent means]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_nonneg}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_rpow_abs_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos}
\difficulty{3}
For $p>0$ and every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the uniform power mean $M_p(f)=(\E|f|^p)^{1/p}$ is nonnegative.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Monotonicity in function values]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_mono}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsNonnegative, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect}
\difficulty{4}
For $p>0$ and functions $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ satisfying $0\le f(x)\le g(x)$ for every $x$, one has $M_p(f)\le M_p(g)$, where $M_p(u)=(\E|u|^p)^{1/p}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Positive homogeneity of power means]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_const_mul}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_rpow_abs_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.expect}
\difficulty{4}
Let $p,c>0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$. With $M_p(u)=(\E|u|^p)^{1/p}$, one has $M_p(cf)=cM_p(f)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Power mean on the empty cube]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_dim_zero}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsNonnegative, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{3}
Let $p>0$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^0\to[0,\infty)$. Its uniform power mean $M_p(f)=(\E f^p)^{1/p}$ equals the value of $f$ at the unique empty string.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Collapsing nested power means]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_collapse_last}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.norm_collapse_rpow, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{4}
Let $p>0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$, and write $M_{p,z}$ for the uniform power mean $(\E_z|\cdot|^p)^{1/p}$. Then $M_{p,(x,b)}f(x,b)=M_{p,x}\bigl(M_{p,b}f(x,b)\bigr)$, where $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $b\in\{0,1\}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Commuting equal-exponent means]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_comm}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{4}
Let $p>0$ and $F:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}\to\bbr$. For uniform power means $M_{p,z}u=(\E_z|u|^p)^{1/p}$, one has $M_{p,x}(M_{p,b}F(x,b))=M_{p,b}(M_{p,x}F(x,b))$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Homogeneity of Fourier coefficients]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_const_mul}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct}
\difficulty{3}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, $c\in\bbr$, and $S\subseteq[n]$, uniform Fourier--Walsh coefficients satisfy $\widehat{cf}(S)=c\widehat f(S)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Homogeneity of noise]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_const_mul}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_const_mul, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and $\rho,c\in\bbr$, the Fourier noise operator satisfies $T_\rho(cf)=cT_\rho f$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Noise on the empty cube]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_dim_zero}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp, BooleanAnalysis.walsh_expansion}
\difficulty{4}
Let $\rho\in\bbr$ and $f:\{0,1\}^0\to\bbr$, the Fourier noise operator satisfies $T_\rho f=f$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Noise preserves nonnegativity]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_nonneg}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsNonnegative, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseKernel_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_eq_kernel_sum, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{3}
Let $0\le\rho\le1$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,\infty)$. Then $T_\rho f(x)\ge0$ at every cube point $x$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Noise on affine one-bit functions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_affine_one_bit}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign, BooleanAnalysis.chiS, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{4}
For $\rho,a\in\bbr$, let $f(b)=1+a(-1)^b$ on $\{0,1\}$. Then $T_\rho f(b)=1+\rho a(-1)^b$ for both bits $b$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Fourier coefficients of averaged restrictions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_avgLast_restrictions}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.avgLast, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.restrictLast, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct}
\difficulty{3}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$, $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$, and $g=(f_0+f_1)/2$. For every $S\subseteq[n]$, $\widehat g(S)=(\widehat{f_0}(S)+\widehat{f_1}(S))/2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Fourier coefficients of differenced restrictions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_diffLast_restrictions}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.diffLast, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.restrictLast, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct}
\difficulty{3}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$, $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$, and $h=(f_0-f_1)/2$. For every $S\subseteq[n]$, $\widehat h(S)=(\widehat{f_0}(S)-\widehat{f_1}(S))/2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Factoring noise by the final coordinate]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_snoc_slice}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.avgLast, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.diffLast, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_avgLast_restrictions, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_diffLast_restrictions, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_dim_zero, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_snoc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.restrictLast, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$, $\rho\in\bbr$, and $f_b(z)=f(z,b)$. For $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $b\in\{0,1\}$, $T_\rho f(x,b)=T_\rho\bigl(t\mapsto T_\rho f_t(x)\bigr)(b)$; the outer operator acts on one bit and the inner operator on $n$ bits. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
\end{lemma}
